title: some more modules

atoms.evidence: class Tanh(nn.Module): ... class LeakyReLU(nn.Module): super().__init__() ... class Sigmoid(nn.Module): ... — three small Module subclasses
LeakyReLU defines extra_repr(self) -> str: return f'negative_slope={self.negative_slope}'
LeakyReLU.forward returns t.where(x > 0, x, self.negative_slope * x) — the elementwise activation pattern from part2; not literally max() but the same one-line elementwise activation idiom

notes: 3 atoms — exactly matches seed prediction of 3. Refresher exercise of three trivial activation modules. The Tanh impl uses (t.exp(x) - t.exp(-x)) / (t.exp(x) + t.exp(-x)); Sigmoid uses 1 / (1 + t.exp(-x)); neither is a learnable atom (just function composition). LeakyReLU's t.where dispatch is the only mildly novel idiom but covered by relu-elementwise-max as the activation pattern.
